example.title: Rattlesnake Creek Bridge, County Road 22 over Rattlesnake Creek
example.place: northwest of Bancroft, Cuming County, NE
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Rattlesnake Creek Bridge (Cuming County, Nebraska))

brief: NRHP-listed pinned Pratt half-hip pony truss of 1903 on a minimum-maintenance gravel county road: latticed channel top chord, eyebar diagonals, a lattice railing panel with a cast 'CAPACITY 10 TONS' plate in it, steel floor beams and a plank deck, on steel pile piers with X-bracing and timber-planked abutments. Grassy, eroded creek banks and cottonwoods in open farmland.

traits.abutments: steel pile bents with timber lagging
